en: Sepia-toned postcard showing a large, rectangular brick school building with a steep roof and gabled ends, in a fairly empty open area. There are a few people and horse-drawn vehicles in front of the building. The image is mounted on a beige card with handwritten French captions at the bottom: on the left, identifying the building as a boys' gymnasium (secondary school), and on the right, noting the city name.
